# Vile trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyBjornUndead | Source: Vile | Usage: Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

The Vile trophy is a rare drop from Viles in the Plains.

### Crafting

• Vilebone Visage

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item Stand.
• Can be used to program the Ballista.
